computerUse.title: Computer Use
computerUse.description: Let agents inspect windows, accessibility elements, and menus, verify results, and operate this computer through the bundled native CUA CLI.
computerUse.warning: Once enabled, it is recommended to use the /computer-use skill to guide AI in operating your computer.
computerUse.off: Disabled. The DeepClaw-managed CUA service is stopped.
computerUse.unavailable: Enabled, but the driver is unavailable. Check permissions and the bundled driver, then turn this off and on to retry.
computerUse.unsupported: Requires macOS 13+ (Intel or Apple silicon), or Windows 10+ x64.
computerUse.permissionHint: Grant DeepClaw the Accessibility and Screen & System Audio Recording permissions so Computer Use works correctly. Restart DeepClaw after changing grants. If a permission request was previously denied or ignored, clicking "Request Permissions" may not show a prompt again; in that case, adjust it manually in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
computerUse.permissionRequestIncomplete: The permission request returned, but required access is still not granted. macOS may not show another dialog, especially after a previous decision. Check the listed app in System Settings, then restart and refresh. This status cannot tell whether access was never requested or previously denied.
computerUse.error: Could not complete the operation. Refresh the status and retry; see application logs for details.

gateway.notRunningDesc: The OpenClaw Gateway needs to be running to use this feature. It will start automatically, or you can start it from Settings.
